featured.titleZh: 香港商务局长：香港必须扩大贸易，不能坐等“运气”，人工智能出口增长或将放缓
featured.summaryZh: 香港商务及经济发展局局长丘应桦表示，香港不能仅依赖运气，必须主动扩大贸易网络。他指出，近期人工智能相关出口的强劲增长趋势可能会逐渐放缓。
featured.whyImportant: 此表态反映了香港政府在面对全球贸易环境不确定性时，寻求多元化经济增长的紧迫感。

featured.title: Gymshark in trademark battle that threatens future of small fitness business
featured.summary: Exclusive: British sportswear firm is seeking to obtain rights to The Conditioning Club, which is also the name of a Gloucestershire gym Gymshark, the £1bn British sportswear firm started in a family garage, is locked in a trademark battle that threatens the future of a small fitness business. Ben Francis, the university dropout who started sewing his own gym clothes in his parents’ garage and is now estimated to be worth £800m, is trying to add The Conditioning Club to his Gymshark stable of trademarks. Continue reading...
featured.titleZh: Gymshark陷入商标纠纷，威胁到小型健身企业的未来
featured.summaryZh: 英国运动服装巨头Gymshark正试图获取“The Conditioning Club”的商标权，而这恰好是一家格洛斯特郡小型健身房的名称。这家估值10亿英镑的公司创始人本·弗朗西斯目前正面临法律争议，其行为可能导致该小型企业陷入困境。
featured.whyImportant: 此案引发了关于大型企业利用商标权挤压小型企业生存空间的讨论。

global.title: Francophone summit opens in Cambodia amid Rwanda-DR Congo rift
global.summary: Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda clash over who should lead the organisation of French-speaking nations.
global.titleZh: 法语国家峰会在柬埔寨开幕，卢旺达与刚果民主共和国关系紧张
global.summaryZh: 法语国家组织峰会在柬埔寨举行，但刚果民主共和国与卢旺达之间因组织领导权问题产生激烈冲突。两国在峰会期间的对立凸显了该地区外交关系的复杂性。
global.whyImportant: 成员国之间的政治分歧可能影响该国际组织在法语国家间的凝聚力与决策效率。

global.title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos
global.summary: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack.
global.titleZh: 电信升级工作如何引发美国航班混乱
global.summaryZh: 美国官员表示，近期发生的航班大面积中断是由旧设备过载引起的，而非网络攻击。相关部门已排除人为破坏的可能性，并将原因归咎于基础设施升级过程中的技术故障。
global.whyImportant: 该事件暴露了航空基础设施对老旧电信系统的依赖及其潜在的系统性风险。

global.title: Family of Watford woman set alight ‘desperate for answers’ after attack
global.summary: Appeal for information comes after Brenda Raymond, 80, was set on fire outside her flat on Monday The family of an elderly woman who was set on fire outside a block of flats in Watford have said they are “desperate for answers”. Brenda Raymond, 80, was found set alight outside her flat on Caractacus Cottage View on Monday. She was taken to a nearby hospital, where she is in critical condition. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 沃特福德老妇遭纵火袭击，家属急寻真相
global.summaryZh: 80岁的布伦达·雷蒙德周一在沃特福德的公寓外被人纵火焚烧，目前伤势危急。其家属正焦急地呼吁公众提供线索，以协助警方调查这起恶性袭击事件。
global.whyImportant: 针对老年人的暴力犯罪引发了社区对公共安全和弱势群体保护的担忧。

global.title: World’s top court to rule if Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
global.summary: International court of justice has never before found a state guilty of genocide, and ruling will have implications for case against Israel The world’s top court will deliver a judgment this week on whether Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, in a landmark case that will set a critical 21st-century benchmark for the gravest of all international crimes. The closely watched judgment could become one of the most significant moments in international law since the end of the second world war. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 世界最高法院将裁定缅甸是否对罗兴亚人实施了种族灭绝
global.summaryZh: 国际法院本周将就缅甸是否对罗兴亚少数民族实施种族灭绝作出裁决。这将是该法院历史上首次判定国家犯下种族灭绝罪，其判决结果将对国际法产生深远影响。
global.whyImportant: 该裁决将为国际法处理此类严重罪行设定新的基准，并可能影响针对其他国家的类似诉讼。

global.title: Planned asylum seeker detention centre next to Oxfordshire sewage works criticised
global.summary: Thames Water says detainees at proposed accommodation should expect to experience insect swarms and strong smells A Home Office plan to build asylum seeker detention facilities next to a sewage pump is facing objections after water company officials warned that detainees should expect to experience insect swarms and strong smells. Proposed secure accommodation blocks at Campsfield House immigration removal centre in Oxfordshire will be 20 metres from a sewage pumping station, according to a written submission from Thames Water. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 拟建在牛津郡污水处理厂旁的寻求庇护者拘留中心遭批评
global.summaryZh: 英国内政部计划在污水泵站旁建设寻求庇护者拘留设施，遭到泰晤士水务公司的反对。该公司警告称，该地点存在严重的昆虫滋扰和恶臭问题，不适合作为居住场所。
global.whyImportant: 此争议凸显了政府在安置寻求庇护者时面临的选址困难及人道主义标准考量。

global.title: NHS England on track to miss key cancer treatment target by 10,000 patients
global.summary: Exclusive: 2,850 more patients a month would need to be treated within 62 days to meet March 2027 goal, as experts warn of failure of leadership Nearly 10,000 more cancer patients in England will not be treated on time because the government will fail to meet its targets, amid a failure of leadership, focus and resource, experts have warned. The NHS set an interim target to treat 80% of cancer patients within 62 days of urgent referral or consultant upgrade by March 2027. But with little more than 100 days to go, the proportion of patients starting treatment on time in September was 70.7%, down from 71.9% in August, NHS figures show. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）癌症治疗目标恐将落空，缺口达1万人
global.summaryZh: 专家警告称，由于领导力不足和资源匮乏，NHS将无法实现到2027年3月让80%癌症患者在62天内接受治疗的目标。目前治疗进度持续下滑，预计将有近万名患者无法按时获得救治。
global.whyImportant: 医疗目标的失败直接关系到癌症患者的生存率，并引发了对英国公共医疗系统管理能力的质疑。

global.title: Anthony Albanese apologises for hot-mic gaffe after Coalition criticises ‘locker-room talk’
global.summary: Prime minister says he and Chris Bowen were having ‘light-hearted banter’ when they were caught discussing where they keep their phones Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast Anthony Albanese has apologised for a hot-mic gaffe at the UN climate talks in Turkey, saying he regretted being overheard discussing mobile phone radiation and “dicks” in a candid conversation. “I of course regret that. I apologise,” Albanese said during a visit to the Australian warship HMAS Stalwart in the Philippines on Sunday. Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯因“热麦克风”失言道歉，遭联盟党批评“更衣室谈话”
global.summaryZh: 澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯在土耳其气候峰会期间，因私下讨论手机辐射等不当言论被麦克风录下。他随后对此表示道歉，称当时只是在进行轻松的闲聊。
global.whyImportant: 政要的非正式言论被公开后引发了政治争议，并受到反对党的严厉抨击。

global.title: UBS unveils new West Kowloon hub to tap Greater Bay Area wealth
global.summary: UBS has drawn back the curtains on its new Hong Kong headquarters in West Kowloon, a 20-storey tower with a client floor built for meetings, dinners and events, as the Swiss lender anchors its regional presence to tap growing wealth across the Greater Bay Area. About 3,500 UBS staff, currently spread across five offices, including Two IFC in Central, are due to start moving in during the fourth quarter. UBS Tower sits within Sun Hung Kai Properties’ International Gateway Centre. It has about...
global.titleZh: 瑞银在西九龙设立新枢纽，旨在挖掘大湾区财富潜力
global.summaryZh: 瑞银集团在香港西九龙启用了全新的办公大楼，旨在巩固其区域地位并吸引大湾区不断增长的财富。约3500名员工将于第四季度开始搬迁至该办公楼。
global.whyImportant: 此举显示了瑞银对香港作为连接大湾区金融枢纽地位的长期信心与战略布局。

global.title: Top tax accountant exam scorer in South Korea admits to using AI to cheat
global.summary: South Korean police said on Sunday they had launched an investigation after the top scorer in a national tax accountant exam confessed to using artificial intelligence to cheat. The test taker, who ranked first in both rounds of the national qualification exam held in April and July, submitted a written confession through his lawyer and acknowledged using AI to obtain answers during the tests. He scored 397.5 out of 400 points in the first round, getting just one of 160 questions wrong, sparking...
global.titleZh: 韩国税务会计师考试状元承认利用人工智能作弊
global.summaryZh: 韩国警方已对一名税务会计师考试状元展开调查，该考生承认在考试中利用人工智能获取答案。他在两轮考试中均获得第一名，且第一轮考试几乎全对。
global.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对人工智能在专业资格考试中诚信风险的广泛关注。

china.title: What a Beijing cafe dispute reveals about China’s struggling bookshops
china.summary: China’s bricks-and-mortar bookstores are increasingly counting on coffee, merchandise and cultural events rather than books to stay afloat – a survival strategy whose tensions were laid bare after a major chain asked a book buyer to vacate its cafe seating unless she bought a drink. The dispute at a Beijing branch of Sisyphe Bookstore, one of the country’s largest chains, went viral earlier this month, sparking an online debate over the struggles bookshops face in the digital age. The customer,...
china.titleZh: 北京书店纠纷揭示中国实体书店的生存困境
china.summaryZh: 中国实体书店日益依赖咖啡、周边商品和文化活动来维持运营，但这种模式引发了关于空间使用权的争议。近期北京一家大型连锁书店因座位消费问题引发的舆论讨论，凸显了书店在数字时代的生存压力。
china.whyImportant: 该事件反映了传统书店在数字化冲击下，试图通过多元化经营实现盈利所面临的现实挑战。

china.title: Hong Kong concert organiser told ‘weeks in advance’ about changed programme: Yuja Wang
china.summary: The internationally acclaimed pianist Yuja Wang has denied making a last-minute change to a recent performance in Hong Kong that resulted in audience refunds, saying the concert organiser was told weeks in advance about the revised programme. In a statement issued on Sunday, the Beijing-born American pianist and the Mahler Chamber Orchestra accused the local organiser, Premiere Performances of Hong Kong, of withholding the announcement of a change that had been “communicated weeks in advance by...
china.titleZh: 王羽佳回应香港音乐会节目变更：主办方数周前已获悉
china.summaryZh: 国际知名钢琴家王羽佳否认在香港演出中临时更改节目，并表示已提前数周通知主办方。她与马勒室内乐团指责主办方未及时向公众披露变更信息。
china.whyImportant: 此争议引发了公众对于演出主办方信息透明度及艺人与主办方沟通机制的讨论。

china.title: No actors, no crew, no ticket sales: ‘So obviously AI’ film flops at China’s box office
china.summary: China has ushered artificial intelligence into its cinemas, but the country’s first fully AI-generated feature film has flopped at the box office. Made with no human actors or camera crew, Sanxingdui: Future Past brought in just around 1.8 million yuan (US$270,000) after three weeks in theatres, according to Chinese box office data tracker Beacon Pro. The figure was well below the film’s reported budget of tens of millions of yuan. The 100-minute sci-fi film is set in a world decades in the...
china.titleZh: 无演员、无剧组、无票房：中国首部AI电影票房惨淡
china.summaryZh: 中国首部完全由人工智能生成的长篇电影《三星堆：未来启示录》在上映三周后仅获得约180万元票房。该片制作成本高达数千万，但最终表现远低于预期。
china.whyImportant: 该片的票房失利表明，目前纯AI制作的电影在内容质量和市场吸引力上仍难以取代传统电影制作。

china.title: Fresh coat, lighter load: Hong Kong airport puts runway-painting robots to work
china.summary: Hong Kong International Airport has become the world’s first to deploy robots to repaint runway markings, cutting the time needed to refresh centre lines by about 67 per cent compared with manual painting, its managing authority has said. According to the Airport Authority, the AI-powered robots, called “Brushman”, also improve painting accuracy and worker safety, reducing the need for physically demanding overnight work and allowing staff to take on supervisory roles. Steven Yiu Siu-chung, the...
china.titleZh: 香港机场启用跑道喷漆机器人，提升效率并减轻人工负担
china.summaryZh: 香港国际机场成为全球首个使用机器人进行跑道标线重绘的机场。这种名为“Brushman”的AI机器人将重绘效率提升了约67%，并改善了工人的作业安全。
china.whyImportant: 此举展示了自动化技术在提升机场基础设施维护效率和安全性方面的应用潜力。

usa.title: How Iran used US troops’ digital footprints to hit Mideast bases for billions in damage
usa.summary: When Iran’s military planners prepared to hit American bases in the Middle East, they relied on intelligence from an unlikely source: US service members themselves. According to security experts and even the US military, Iran harvested data from social media accounts, fitness apps and even ads to establish patterns of life in US bases across the region. Paired with imagery reportedly provided by Russian satellites, the Iranians selecting the targets constructed a surprisingly accurate picture of...
usa.titleZh: 伊朗如何利用美军数字足迹袭击中东基地并造成数十亿美元损失
usa.summaryZh: 伊朗军方通过收集美军人员在社交媒体、健身应用及广告中的数据，掌握了美军在中东基地的生活规律。结合俄罗斯卫星提供的图像，伊朗成功定位并袭击了相关目标。
usa.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了现代军事人员在数字时代面临的严重信息安全与情报泄露风险。

usa.title: When the rains fail: Preparing for drought in Central America
usa.summary: Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains. In southwestern Honduras, Anastacio Martínez Gómez has spent most of his 73 years learning to work the land. But experience can only take him so far.
usa.titleZh: 当雨水不再：中美洲干旱应对准备
usa.summaryZh: 在中美洲的“干旱走廊”，农户的生计高度依赖降雨。尽管当地农民拥有丰富的耕作经验，但在日益严峻的干旱面前，这些经验已难以应对挑战。
usa.whyImportant: 该报道揭示了气候变化对中美洲农业社区生存能力的严重威胁。

watch.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts suspected Houthi missiles and drones
watch.summary: Fighting escalates in Yemen's Marib and al-Jawf, as UN agency says more than 340,000 Yemenis displaced since August.
watch.titleZh: 沙特领导的联军拦截疑似胡塞武装导弹和无人机
watch.summaryZh: 也门马里布和焦夫地区的冲突持续升级。联合国机构指出，自8月以来，也门境内已有超过34万人流离失所。
watch.whyImportant: 也门冲突的加剧进一步恶化了当地的人道主义危机。

watch.title: AI ‘blue aliens’ rising as health experts on China social media spark pseudoscience backlash
watch.summary: In China, some influential online voices offering health advice are neither doctors nor academics, but AI-generated blue aliens. Depicted as emissaries from an advanced civilisation, the bald, blue-skinned digital figures have humanlike bodies and glowing markings across their heads. The phenomenon reportedly traces its origins to Wanxiang Science, a popular-science channel on Douyin with more than 1.5 million followers. The account traditionally covered physics, but struck viral gold in August...
watch.titleZh: AI“蓝色外星人”变身健康专家，中国社交媒体引发伪科学争议
watch.summaryZh: 中国社交媒体上出现了一批由AI生成的“蓝色外星人”形象，它们以先进文明使者的身份提供健康建议。这些账号并非由专业医生或学者运营，引发了公众对伪科学传播的担忧。
watch.whyImportant: 该现象反映了AI生成内容在健康信息传播中带来的监管与科学性挑战。

watch.title: Chinese social media firms under fire as fake history spreads online
watch.summary: Pseudo-history about China is mushrooming online, spreading fake accounts of the past due in large part to platform algorithms, artificial intelligence (AI) and a lack of monitoring, according to a Chinese provincial authority. watch.titleZh: 虚假历史在网上蔓延，中国社交媒体公司面临压力
watch.summaryZh: 中国浙江省相关部门指出，受平台算法和AI技术影响，网络上伪历史内容泛滥。尽管监管部门多次打击，但此类虚假叙事仍借助技术手段不断滋生。
watch.whyImportant: 这凸显了社交媒体平台在遏制虚假信息传播方面所面临的治理难题。

more.title: For Bangladesh and others, climate disasters should not add to debt burdens
more.summary: Talks at Cop31, the United Nations climate change conference being held in Antalya, Turkey, come at a critical moment for climate-vulnerable countries across the Global South. Bangladesh is among those bearing the brunt of climate change despite having negligible historical responsibility for global emissions. As delegations negotiate how to finance climate action, the “how” matters no less than the “how much”: support must arrive in time, reach those who need it and avoid deepening debt. The...
more.titleZh: 对于孟加拉国及其他国家而言，气候灾难不应加重债务负担
more.summaryZh: 在土耳其安塔利亚举行的COP31气候大会上，气候脆弱国家呼吁国际社会提供及时的气候融资。各方强调，援助资金应避免让受灾国陷入更深的债务危机。
more.whyImportant: 该议题关乎全球气候治理中资金分配的公平性与可持续性。

items.summary: Hong Kong must proactively expand trade networks and not “wait for luck to come our way”, as the recent growth in artificial intelligence exports may gradually slow down, the city’s commerce minister has said. Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau Ying-wah said on Sunday that Hong Kong’s September export growth rate – the highest monthly figure in more than 40 years – was driven by an increase in re-export volume equivalent to 1.4 times the city’s gross domestic...
items.titleZh: 香港商务局长：香港必须扩大贸易，不能坐等“运气”，人工智能出口增长或将放缓
items.summaryZh: 香港商务及经济发展局局长丘应桦表示，香港不能仅依赖运气，必须主动扩大贸易网络。他指出，近期人工智能相关出口的强劲增长趋势可能会逐渐放缓。
items.whyImportant: 此表态反映了香港政府在面对全球贸易环境不确定性时，寻求多元化经济增长的紧迫感。

items.title: Gymshark in trademark battle that threatens future of small fitness business
items.summary: Exclusive: British sportswear firm is seeking to obtain rights to The Conditioning Club, which is also the name of a Gloucestershire gym Gymshark, the £1bn British sportswear firm started in a family garage, is locked in a trademark battle that threatens the future of a small fitness business. Ben Francis, the university dropout who started sewing his own gym clothes in his parents’ garage and is now estimated to be worth £800m, is trying to add The Conditioning Club to his Gymshark stable of trademarks. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: Gymshark陷入商标纠纷，威胁到小型健身企业的未来
items.summaryZh: 英国运动服装巨头Gymshark正试图获取“The Conditioning Club”的商标权，而这恰好是一家格洛斯特郡小型健身房的名称。这家估值10亿英镑的公司创始人本·弗朗西斯目前正面临法律争议，其行为可能导致该小型企业陷入困境。
items.whyImportant: 此案引发了关于大型企业利用商标权挤压小型企业生存空间的讨论。

items.title: Francophone summit opens in Cambodia amid Rwanda-DR Congo rift
items.summary: Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda clash over who should lead the organisation of French-speaking nations.
items.titleZh: 法语国家峰会在柬埔寨开幕，卢旺达与刚果民主共和国关系紧张
items.summaryZh: 法语国家组织峰会在柬埔寨举行，但刚果民主共和国与卢旺达之间因组织领导权问题产生激烈冲突。两国在峰会期间的对立凸显了该地区外交关系的复杂性。
items.whyImportant: 成员国之间的政治分歧可能影响该国际组织在法语国家间的凝聚力与决策效率。

items.title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos
items.summary: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack.
items.titleZh: 电信升级工作如何引发美国航班混乱
items.summaryZh: 美国官员表示，近期发生的航班大面积中断是由旧设备过载引起的，而非网络攻击。相关部门已排除人为破坏的可能性，并将原因归咎于基础设施升级过程中的技术故障。
items.whyImportant: 该事件暴露了航空基础设施对老旧电信系统的依赖及其潜在的系统性风险。

items.title: Family of Watford woman set alight ‘desperate for answers’ after attack
items.summary: Appeal for information comes after Brenda Raymond, 80, was set on fire outside her flat on Monday The family of an elderly woman who was set on fire outside a block of flats in Watford have said they are “desperate for answers”. Brenda Raymond, 80, was found set alight outside her flat on Caractacus Cottage View on Monday. She was taken to a nearby hospital, where she is in critical condition. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 沃特福德老妇遭纵火袭击，家属急寻真相
items.summaryZh: 80岁的布伦达·雷蒙德周一在沃特福德的公寓外被人纵火焚烧，目前伤势危急。其家属正焦急地呼吁公众提供线索，以协助警方调查这起恶性袭击事件。
items.whyImportant: 针对老年人的暴力犯罪引发了社区对公共安全和弱势群体保护的担忧。

items.title: World’s top court to rule if Myanmar committed genocide against Rohingya
items.summary: International court of justice has never before found a state guilty of genocide, and ruling will have implications for case against Israel The world’s top court will deliver a judgment this week on whether Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya minority, in a landmark case that will set a critical 21st-century benchmark for the gravest of all international crimes. The closely watched judgment could become one of the most significant moments in international law since the end of the second world war. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 世界最高法院将裁定缅甸是否对罗兴亚人实施了种族灭绝
items.summaryZh: 国际法院本周将就缅甸是否对罗兴亚少数民族实施种族灭绝作出裁决。这将是该法院历史上首次判定国家犯下种族灭绝罪，其判决结果将对国际法产生深远影响。
items.whyImportant: 该裁决将为国际法处理此类严重罪行设定新的基准，并可能影响针对其他国家的类似诉讼。

items.title: Planned asylum seeker detention centre next to Oxfordshire sewage works criticised
items.summary: Thames Water says detainees at proposed accommodation should expect to experience insect swarms and strong smells A Home Office plan to build asylum seeker detention facilities next to a sewage pump is facing objections after water company officials warned that detainees should expect to experience insect swarms and strong smells. Proposed secure accommodation blocks at Campsfield House immigration removal centre in Oxfordshire will be 20 metres from a sewage pumping station, according to a written submission from Thames Water. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 拟建在牛津郡污水处理厂旁的寻求庇护者拘留中心遭批评
items.summaryZh: 英国内政部计划在污水泵站旁建设寻求庇护者拘留设施，遭到泰晤士水务公司的反对。该公司警告称，该地点存在严重的昆虫滋扰和恶臭问题，不适合作为居住场所。
items.whyImportant: 此争议凸显了政府在安置寻求庇护者时面临的选址困难及人道主义标准考量。

items.title: NHS England on track to miss key cancer treatment target by 10,000 patients
items.summary: Exclusive: 2,850 more patients a month would need to be treated within 62 days to meet March 2027 goal, as experts warn of failure of leadership Nearly 10,000 more cancer patients in England will not be treated on time because the government will fail to meet its targets, amid a failure of leadership, focus and resource, experts have warned. The NHS set an interim target to treat 80% of cancer patients within 62 days of urgent referral or consultant upgrade by March 2027. But with little more than 100 days to go, the proportion of patients starting treatment on time in September was 70.7%, down from 71.9% in August, NHS figures show. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 英国国家医疗服务体系（NHS）癌症治疗目标恐将落空，缺口达1万人
items.summaryZh: 专家警告称，由于领导力不足和资源匮乏，NHS将无法实现到2027年3月让80%癌症患者在62天内接受治疗的目标。目前治疗进度持续下滑，预计将有近万名患者无法按时获得救治。
items.whyImportant: 医疗目标的失败直接关系到癌症患者的生存率，并引发了对英国公共医疗系统管理能力的质疑。

items.title: Anthony Albanese apologises for hot-mic gaffe after Coalition criticises ‘locker-room talk’
items.summary: Prime minister says he and Chris Bowen were having ‘light-hearted banter’ when they were caught discussing where they keep their phones Get our daily political email, free app or daily news podcast Anthony Albanese has apologised for a hot-mic gaffe at the UN climate talks in Turkey, saying he regretted being overheard discussing mobile phone radiation and “dicks” in a candid conversation. “I of course regret that. I apologise,” Albanese said during a visit to the Australian warship HMAS Stalwart in the Philippines on Sunday. Sign up for Guardian Australia’s Politics, really newsletter here Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 安东尼·阿尔巴尼斯因“热麦克风”失言道歉，遭联盟党批评“更衣室谈话”
items.summaryZh: 澳大利亚总理阿尔巴尼斯在土耳其气候峰会期间，因私下讨论手机辐射等不当言论被麦克风录下。他随后对此表示道歉，称当时只是在进行轻松的闲聊。
items.whyImportant: 政要的非正式言论被公开后引发了政治争议，并受到反对党的严厉抨击。

items.title: UBS unveils new West Kowloon hub to tap Greater Bay Area wealth
items.summary: UBS has drawn back the curtains on its new Hong Kong headquarters in West Kowloon, a 20-storey tower with a client floor built for meetings, dinners and events, as the Swiss lender anchors its regional presence to tap growing wealth across the Greater Bay Area. About 3,500 UBS staff, currently spread across five offices, including Two IFC in Central, are due to start moving in during the fourth quarter. UBS Tower sits within Sun Hung Kai Properties’ International Gateway Centre. It has about...
items.titleZh: 瑞银在西九龙设立新枢纽，旨在挖掘大湾区财富潜力
items.summaryZh: 瑞银集团在香港西九龙启用了全新的办公大楼，旨在巩固其区域地位并吸引大湾区不断增长的财富。约3500名员工将于第四季度开始搬迁至该办公楼。
items.whyImportant: 此举显示了瑞银对香港作为连接大湾区金融枢纽地位的长期信心与战略布局。

items.title: Top tax accountant exam scorer in South Korea admits to using AI to cheat
items.summary: South Korean police said on Sunday they had launched an investigation after the top scorer in a national tax accountant exam confessed to using artificial intelligence to cheat. The test taker, who ranked first in both rounds of the national qualification exam held in April and July, submitted a written confession through his lawyer and acknowledged using AI to obtain answers during the tests. He scored 397.5 out of 400 points in the first round, getting just one of 160 questions wrong, sparking...
items.titleZh: 韩国税务会计师考试状元承认利用人工智能作弊
items.summaryZh: 韩国警方已对一名税务会计师考试状元展开调查，该考生承认在考试中利用人工智能获取答案。他在两轮考试中均获得第一名，且第一轮考试几乎全对。
items.whyImportant: 该事件引发了公众对人工智能在专业资格考试中诚信风险的广泛关注。

items.title: What a Beijing cafe dispute reveals about China’s struggling bookshops
items.summary: China’s bricks-and-mortar bookstores are increasingly counting on coffee, merchandise and cultural events rather than books to stay afloat – a survival strategy whose tensions were laid bare after a major chain asked a book buyer to vacate its cafe seating unless she bought a drink. The dispute at a Beijing branch of Sisyphe Bookstore, one of the country’s largest chains, went viral earlier this month, sparking an online debate over the struggles bookshops face in the digital age. The customer,...
items.titleZh: 北京书店纠纷揭示中国实体书店的生存困境
items.summaryZh: 中国实体书店日益依赖咖啡、周边商品和文化活动来维持运营，但这种模式引发了关于空间使用权的争议。近期北京一家大型连锁书店因座位消费问题引发的舆论讨论，凸显了书店在数字时代的生存压力。
items.whyImportant: 该事件反映了传统书店在数字化冲击下，试图通过多元化经营实现盈利所面临的现实挑战。

items.title: Hong Kong concert organiser told ‘weeks in advance’ about changed programme: Yuja Wang
items.summary: The internationally acclaimed pianist Yuja Wang has denied making a last-minute change to a recent performance in Hong Kong that resulted in audience refunds, saying the concert organiser was told weeks in advance about the revised programme. In a statement issued on Sunday, the Beijing-born American pianist and the Mahler Chamber Orchestra accused the local organiser, Premiere Performances of Hong Kong, of withholding the announcement of a change that had been “communicated weeks in advance by...
items.titleZh: 王羽佳回应香港音乐会节目变更：主办方数周前已获悉
items.summaryZh: 国际知名钢琴家王羽佳否认在香港演出中临时更改节目，并表示已提前数周通知主办方。她与马勒室内乐团指责主办方未及时向公众披露变更信息。
items.whyImportant: 此争议引发了公众对于演出主办方信息透明度及艺人与主办方沟通机制的讨论。

items.title: No actors, no crew, no ticket sales: ‘So obviously AI’ film flops at China’s box office
items.summary: China has ushered artificial intelligence into its cinemas, but the country’s first fully AI-generated feature film has flopped at the box office. Made with no human actors or camera crew, Sanxingdui: Future Past brought in just around 1.8 million yuan (US$270,000) after three weeks in theatres, according to Chinese box office data tracker Beacon Pro. The figure was well below the film’s reported budget of tens of millions of yuan. The 100-minute sci-fi film is set in a world decades in the...
items.titleZh: 无演员、无剧组、无票房：中国首部AI电影票房惨淡
items.summaryZh: 中国首部完全由人工智能生成的长篇电影《三星堆：未来启示录》在上映三周后仅获得约180万元票房。该片制作成本高达数千万，但最终表现远低于预期。
items.whyImportant: 该片的票房失利表明，目前纯AI制作的电影在内容质量和市场吸引力上仍难以取代传统电影制作。

items.title: Fresh coat, lighter load: Hong Kong airport puts runway-painting robots to work
items.summary: Hong Kong International Airport has become the world’s first to deploy robots to repaint runway markings, cutting the time needed to refresh centre lines by about 67 per cent compared with manual painting, its managing authority has said. According to the Airport Authority, the AI-powered robots, called “Brushman”, also improve painting accuracy and worker safety, reducing the need for physically demanding overnight work and allowing staff to take on supervisory roles. Steven Yiu Siu-chung, the...
items.titleZh: 香港机场启用跑道喷漆机器人，提升效率并减轻人工负担
items.summaryZh: 香港国际机场成为全球首个使用机器人进行跑道标线重绘的机场。这种名为“Brushman”的AI机器人将重绘效率提升了约67%，并改善了工人的作业安全。
items.whyImportant: 此举展示了自动化技术在提升机场基础设施维护效率和安全性方面的应用潜力。

items.title: How Iran used US troops’ digital footprints to hit Mideast bases for billions in damage
items.summary: When Iran’s military planners prepared to hit American bases in the Middle East, they relied on intelligence from an unlikely source: US service members themselves. According to security experts and even the US military, Iran harvested data from social media accounts, fitness apps and even ads to establish patterns of life in US bases across the region. Paired with imagery reportedly provided by Russian satellites, the Iranians selecting the targets constructed a surprisingly accurate picture of...
items.titleZh: 伊朗如何利用美军数字足迹袭击中东基地并造成数十亿美元损失
items.summaryZh: 伊朗军方通过收集美军人员在社交媒体、健身应用及广告中的数据，掌握了美军在中东基地的生活规律。结合俄罗斯卫星提供的图像，伊朗成功定位并袭击了相关目标。
items.whyImportant: 该事件凸显了现代军事人员在数字时代面临的严重信息安全与情报泄露风险。

items.title: When the rains fail: Preparing for drought in Central America
items.summary: Across Central America’s so-called Dry Corridor, farming families live at the mercy of the rains. In southwestern Honduras, Anastacio Martínez Gómez has spent most of his 73 years learning to work the land. But experience can only take him so far.
items.titleZh: 当雨水不再：中美洲干旱应对准备
items.summaryZh: 在中美洲的“干旱走廊”，农户的生计高度依赖降雨。尽管当地农民拥有丰富的耕作经验，但在日益严峻的干旱面前，这些经验已难以应对挑战。
items.whyImportant: 该报道揭示了气候变化对中美洲农业社区生存能力的严重威胁。

items.title: Saudi-led coalition intercepts suspected Houthi missiles and drones
items.summary: Fighting escalates in Yemen's Marib and al-Jawf, as UN agency says more than 340,000 Yemenis displaced since August.
items.titleZh: 沙特领导的联军拦截疑似胡塞武装导弹和无人机
items.summaryZh: 也门马里布和焦夫地区的冲突持续升级。联合国机构指出，自8月以来，也门境内已有超过34万人流离失所。
items.whyImportant: 也门冲突的加剧进一步恶化了当地的人道主义危机。

items.title: AI ‘blue aliens’ rising as health experts on China social media spark pseudoscience backlash
items.summary: In China, some influential online voices offering health advice are neither doctors nor academics, but AI-generated blue aliens. Depicted as emissaries from an advanced civilisation, the bald, blue-skinned digital figures have humanlike bodies and glowing markings across their heads. The phenomenon reportedly traces its origins to Wanxiang Science, a popular-science channel on Douyin with more than 1.5 million followers. The account traditionally covered physics, but struck viral gold in August...
items.titleZh: AI“蓝色外星人”变身健康专家，中国社交媒体引发伪科学争议
items.summaryZh: 中国社交媒体上出现了一批由AI生成的“蓝色外星人”形象，它们以先进文明使者的身份提供健康建议。这些账号并非由专业医生或学者运营，引发了公众对伪科学传播的担忧。
items.whyImportant: 该现象反映了AI生成内容在健康信息传播中带来的监管与科学性挑战。

items.title: Chinese social media firms under fire as fake history spreads online
items.summary: Pseudo-history about China is mushrooming online, spreading fake accounts of the past due in large part to platform algorithms, artificial intelligence (AI) and a lack of monitoring, according to a Chinese provincial authority. In a commentary published on Monday, “Zhejiang Propaganda” – a social media account affiliated with the propaganda department of the province’s Communist Party committee – said the “pseudo-historical school” was gaining ground online, resurfacing despite crackdowns and...
items.titleZh: 虚假历史在网上蔓延，中国社交媒体公司面临压力
items.summaryZh: 中国浙江省相关部门指出，受平台算法和AI技术影响，网络上伪历史内容泛滥。尽管监管部门多次打击，但此类虚假叙事仍借助技术手段不断滋生。
items.whyImportant: 这凸显了社交媒体平台在遏制虚假信息传播方面所面临的治理难题。

items.title: For Bangladesh and others, climate disasters should not add to debt burdens
items.summary: Talks at Cop31, the United Nations climate change conference being held in Antalya, Turkey, come at a critical moment for climate-vulnerable countries across the Global South. Bangladesh is among those bearing the brunt of climate change despite having negligible historical responsibility for global emissions. As delegations negotiate how to finance climate action, the “how” matters no less than the “how much”: support must arrive in time, reach those who need it and avoid deepening debt. The...
items.titleZh: 对于孟加拉国及其他国家而言，气候灾难不应加重债务负担
items.summaryZh: 在土耳其安塔利亚举行的COP31气候大会上，气候脆弱国家呼吁国际社会提供及时的气候融资。各方强调，援助资金应避免让受灾国陷入更深的债务危机。
items.whyImportant: 该议题关乎全球气候治理中资金分配的公平性与可持续性。
